title: WPSS/1454/2026 of ALKA JOSHI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
WPSS No.1454 of 2026
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. A.M. Saklani, learned Counsel for the
petitioner.
2. Mr. R.C. Joshi, learned B.H. for the State.
3. Mr. Rajesh Sharma, learned Counsel for
respondent no.3.
4. This writ petition has been filed by petitioner
seeking a direction to the respondents to make payment
of GPF to the petitioner along with interest @10% per
annum from the date of her retirement till the actual
payment is made.
5. Learned Counsel for petitioner submits that
petitioner, who was working as Assistant Teacher in the
Education Department of the State, retired from her
service on 31.10.2025. For the last more than seven
months, GPF of petitioner has not been paid.
6. A Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has directed the
respondents to seek instructions into the matter as to
why the GPF amount has not been paid to the
petitioner. Today, instructions have been received by
the respondents. The same are produced before the
Court and are taken on record.
7. It is contended by learned State Counsel that
petitioner was appointed on 21.12.2005 as Assistant
Teacher, Primary School and she was under the New
Pension Scheme (NPS) where there was no provision for
contribution towards GPF. The services of petitioner
stood transferred to the Old Pension Scheme on
06.03.2025. Since the petitioner had retired on
31.10.2025, no contribution was made by petitioner in

2026:UHC:4627
the GPF account which was allotted to petitioner only on
08.10.2025. He further informed this Court that the
amount deposited by petitioner in the contributory
provident fund under the New Pension Scheme is to be
transferred to the new GPF Account.
8. According to petitioner, GPF Account No.COEDUA-54230 was allotted to petitioner on 08.10.2025,
information of which was received in the office of
respondent no.2 on 13.10.2025. The respondents
further informed that the amount deposited in the
contributory provident fund by petitioner is yet to be
transferred in the aforesaid GPF account of petitioner
and the process is on for which petitioner was also
informed by respondent no.4 on 26.05.2026.
9. In such view of the matter, since the process for
payment of GPF including contributory provident fund
contributed by petitioner under the NPS is underway,
this Court expects from the respondents to take a
speedy decision thereon.
10. The present petition is thus, finally disposed of.
The respondents are directed to ensure making payment
of 90% of GPF amount to petitioner within two months
from today. Remaining 10% GPF amount be paid to the
petitioner within one month thereafter along with
interest calculated on the amount as per rules.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 10.06.2026 R.Dang
